description: Issue #149: a profile cannot re-open the hole #50 closed. `add: ["spec/{dir}**/{base}_spec.rb"]` mixes glob syntax into the template vocabulary — the `**` would match paths the issue never declared, which is exactly the bare-glob permission invariant 1 forbids. Refused at profile load (load_error, exit 6), before an issue is even read, so no plan carrying it can exist to be dispatched. The declaration carries a real placeholder ON PURPOSE: a bare `**/*_spec.rb` is caught twice over (no placeholder either), so it would not tell us which check is doing the work.
